verdict.rationale: PostHog is a SaaS analytics platform with many AI features, so a buyer could fairly ask about an AI-training opt-out. However, the evidence pack contains no documented policy, setting, or contractual commitment preventing customer data from being used to train AI models. Adjacent items such as self-hosting, PostHog AI respecting access controls, and Replay Vision sending recordings to Gemini do not establish a training opt-out and earn no credit.
